items.title: Review & Preview: Rainy Days and Mondays
items.summary: The War in Iran and its impact on oil prices are once again weighing on the market’s mood to start the week on a drizzly New York Monday; expectations for more interest rate increases aren’t helping.  The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite didn’t fare much better, falling 0.8% and 0.9%, respectively.  President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s truce proposal last week, pushing up oil prices across the board.

items.title: Is eBay Stock Priced Right Against Its Peers?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) turns more of its sales into operating profit than Amazon, Walmart, MercadoLibre, Etsy or Target. Yet you pay less for each dollar of eBay's profit than for Walmart's or MercadoLibre's. Is eBay stock discounted against those two for a real worry, or simply priced below what it delivers.

items.title: Target (TGT) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value Following Merchandising Refresh
items.summary: Target has had a strong run over the past year, so the live question now is whether the current share price is adequately backed by the cash the business is expected to generate. With the stock closing at US$157.45 most recently, the issue for anyone watching Target is how much of its cash flow story is already reflected in that tag.
